stem.en: Suppose "Can it fly?" were the only test for birds. Which bird would this test wrongly leave out?

text.en: An ostrich, which has feathers but cannot fly.

feedback.en: Right. An ostrich has feathers and lays hard-shelled eggs, so it is a bird that cannot fly.

text.en: A sparrow, because its wings cannot lift it off the ground.

feedback.en: A sparrow can fly, so the test would keep it in.

text.en: A bat, because it is a bird that flies at night.

feedback.en: A bat is a mammal, so the test could not leave out a bird here.

text.en: No bird, because every bird is able to fly.

feedback.en: An ostrich cannot fly, and it is still a bird.

explanation.en: An ostrich cannot fly, yet it has feathers and lays hard-shelled eggs. Feathers mark a bird; flying does not.

hints.en: Think of a large bird that runs and never flies.
